### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone

Problems: P1 clean-span relief owed (agent write) -> P0 action-plan relief (customer's own write). Order: P1 then P0.

Hop P0 <- P1 — **state-derived.** Visible sentence (action-plan hub): "Action-plan relief is fixed only after the standing record carries a points-expiry entry for every clean-span relief owed on it." It names a record state: a points-expiry entry for each clean-span relief owed. Query returns: standing activity has only two expiry entries (2026-01-05, 2026-07-14), the latter only 2 whole months after the most recent violation. Searching with the sentence's words ("clean-span relief points-expiry entry") reaches "Clean-Span Relief: A Seller Performance Standing Points Entitlement", whose own rule says when it is owed (all conditions met, see 4a) and that it is booked "as one points-expiry entry" with the agent-side tool. Combining: the state does not hold, it is owed today, so it must be booked before the action-plan figure is fixed. No sentence handed me a tool name or route for this hop: the clean-span document is reached through the state words, and its tool is named only in its own hub.

Other candidate hops checked and excluded: listing-type expiry (V4/V5 at 4 whole months; even the 6-month base period has not run; with factors 5 starting + 2 repeat + 1 stock-hold = 8 months), serious step-down (V3 at 5 whole months < 6), top-performer relief (level not Top Rated/Preferred Partner; not evaluation day). None is a prerequisite of action-plan relief anyway.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Do-only-the-one-thing (apply action-plan relief on the record as it stands) is excluded by the visible hub sentence above + the clean-span entitlement rule + the activity rows: the governed result (the action-plan figure) would be fixed on a record lacking an owed clean-span entry, which the hub forbids; the figure would be 4 instead of 3.
- Closest alternative counts: V2 (2025-09-14) at exactly twelve whole months — excluded by the 12-month boundary tables (rate doc "15 September ... 12 | no"; share doc "fewer than twelve whole months"); including it would give count 4 (no 0.3 rate), count 3 (no 0.35 share), single-type count 3 (no credit).
- Coverage tier: the RTS fee (2026-03-06, 6 months) is outside three months; the disposal fee (1 month) is inside -> all active points, not listing-type or listing-policy only.
- "Clean span" for the band: measured from the most recent violation of any type (V5), 4 months -> the shorter-span band; the 6-month band excluded.
- Already-received test: the 2026-07-14 entry is 2 whole months after V5, so the "three or more whole calendar months after" exclusion does not fire.
- Booking target: after clean-span, V3 (3) still carries the most points; V4/V5 (2 each) excluded; V1/V2 fully expired ("never receives relief").
